Question 2
?

Consider the set A, defined as

A={an:an+1=an−5,a1=0,n∈N}.

Which of the following sets is equivalent to A?

a
{0,−5,−10,−15,−20,…}
b
{0,−5,−10,−15,−45,…}
c
{0,−5,−10,−25,−30,…}
d
{0,−5,−10,−20,−30,…}
e
{0,−5,−10,−25,−50,…}
